beat: Homebound car: reciprocal teasing about Raj and Sharmi

lines.original: John: thats was indeed a big step for you...hehe
lines.local: John: Yeh toh tumhare liye sach mein bada step tha! Hehe.

lines.original: Dhika:not you too... I have hugged people... don't tease now...
lines.local: Dhika: Tum bhi shuru mat ho jao. Maine logon ko pehle bhi hug kiya hai, ab mat chhedo.

lines.original: John: hehe.... not many... especially a stranger....
lines.local: John: Hehe, zyada logon ko nahi; khaaskar kisi stranger ko toh bilkul nahi.

lines.original: Dhika: heeeee... Raj is Sharmi's husband and... smiling... a proper gentleman... not like you.. you drank wine....
lines.local: Dhika: Hee... Raj, Sharmi ka husband hai aur... smile ke saath... ek proper gentleman, tumhari tarah nahi. Tumne wine bhi pee.

lines.original: John: hehe... Sharmi thrusted into my hands and I couldn't decline.... oh this Sharmi... she is too naughty....kept flirting all the time...
lines.local: John: Hehe, Sharmi ne jabardasti haath mein glass de diya, mana hi nahi kar paaya. Oh, yeh Sharmi kitni naughty hai—poori shaam flirt karti rahi!

lines.original: Dhika: hehe.... I know... she always teases me that she will take you away from you.... she has a crush on you..hehe
lines.local: Dhika: Hehe, mujhe pata hai. Woh hamesha chhedti hai ki tumhe mujhse chheen legi. Use tum par crush hai!

lines.original: Dhika: what???? she pouted her lips....
John: she can keep me... but end of the day I will come running to you.....
lines.local: John: Woh mujhe rakh sakti hai, par din ke aakhir mein main bhaagkar tumhare paas hi aaunga.

lines.original: Dhika hit him again for telling that Sharmi can have him... but then kissed him for saying that he will come back to her....
lines.local: Dhika ne pehle Sharmi ko John rakhne dene waali baat par use dobara maara, phir wapas apne paas aane ki baat sunkar kiss kiya.

lines.original: ...All the way back, John kept teasing her for hugging and giggling with Raj, while Dhika got back at him for flirting with Sharmi.
lines.local: Raaste bhar John, Dhika ko Raj ke saath hug aur giggles par chhedta raha; Dhika bhi Sharmi ke saath uske flirt ka mazaak banaati rahi.
